children: Sri Lankan shares closed higher on Monday, led by gains in real estate and utilities stocks.
were the top percentage gainers on the index, up 13.7% and 10.3%, respectively.
* Trading volume on the index fell to 50.6 million shares from 66.5 million shares in the previous session.
* The equity market's turnover dipped to 1.01 billion Sri Lankan rupees ($3.1 million) from 2.20 billion rupees in the previous session, according to exchange data.
* Foreign investors were net buyers, purchasing stocks worth 50.9 million rupees, while domestic investors were net sellers, offloading shares worth 982.7 million rupees, the data showed.
